PX22-03.name: Nijimiya Toya
PX22-03.effect:
[Core Charge: (Red) (Core Charge via summon/advent only once per turn)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can summon a Cost 4 or less Red-only Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost. Or, +2 cores to this Nexus, and you can use the [Accel] of a Red-only Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) Send three cores from your Trash, besides [Soul Core], to a Red Spirit you control.

PX22-05.name: Rikudou Souji
PX22-05.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Purple) (Core Charge via summon/advent only once per turn)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
+3 cores to this Nexus. Then, you can summon an "Evil Deity" family Spirit card with two symbols or less from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) During this turn, increase the number of cores your "Core Removal Effects" would send to the Reserve/Trash by +2.

PX22-04.name: Shiratori Yuu
PX22-04.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (White) (Core Charge via summon/advent only once per turn)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
+2 cores to this Nexus. Then, you can reveal five cards from your decktop. Add a Cost 4 or less White-only Spirit card among them to your Hand. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[Grand Skill: 5] [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send five cores from this Nexus to the Void) Refresh a White-only Spirit you control.

PX22-06.name: Wanderer Dan
PX22-06.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Winged Dragon & Cost 0/3 or more) (Core Charge via summon of Cost 0 only once per turn)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) Draw a card. Or, destroy an opposing Nexus, and the effects of the destroyed Nexus can't activate.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When the opponent Rebirth, send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to any of your Spirits/your Reserve.
